title: Video steps artifact
description: Ordered, reader-parity step list produced by a /video run and consumed by /article. idx must be contiguous and 1-based; each step must carry both a screenshot file and a written instruction (no orphans).

idx.description: 1-based position; must be contiguous across the array (validated by validateSteps).

action.description: Open string. Known set: click, type, reveal, nav. A novel action still validates so it can render generically.

file.description: Per-step screenshot path. Required — its absence is an orphan.

instruction.description: Written step text. Required — its absence is an orphan.
